background.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: pixel-art point-and-click game background, landscape 3:2, no character. Input images: the two most recent user attachments are references only; first is the desired environment, second is the player design and must NOT appear in this background. Create a detailed 8-bit/16-bit pixel-art industrial courtyard based closely on the first reference: abandoned brutalist factory buildings, heavy riveted dark olive machinery, moss and dangling vines, pipes, lime-green illuminated vents and control panels, ominous red smoky sky with distant ruined tower silhouettes, central closed metal shutter, faint red steam rising from floor grates at the left and right. Frontal three-quarter room perspective, crisp stepped pixel edges, densely dithered materials, black outlines, rusty steel, deep shadows, warm red rim lighting. The lower 36 percent is a broad unobstructed tiled stone-and-metal courtyard floor suitable for walking a small game character around; extend it all the way to the bottom edge. Buildings frame the left and right with a central facade, matching the supplied reference composition. No people, no creatures, no character, no text, no logos, no interface, no borders. Full-bleed finished game environment.

sprite.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art game sprite sheet. Reference: among the two most recent images, the isolated full-body antlered olive-armored robot knight is the character identity reference; the industrial courtyard is mood only, do NOT include any scene. Create one square PNG sprite sheet divided into EXACTLY 2 columns and 2 rows of equal square cells with NO divider lines. Every cell contains ONE full-body pixel sprite of the SAME character from the supplied isolated character reference: olive-green futuristic armored warrior, large branching brown deer antlers, helmet with wide silver segmented horizontal visor, black inset armor joints, bright lime-green throat lights, chest light and wrist details, heavy angular boots. Preserve this design very closely. In each of the four equal cells, keep exactly the same sprite scale, position, head height and foot baseline, with transparent margins around all antlers and boots. All sprites front-facing. Top left: neutral standing legs together, arms at sides. Top right: left foot stepping forward, right foot back, opposite arm swing, one-pixel body bob. Bottom left: passing step with legs nearly together and arms passing neutral. Bottom right: right foot stepping forward, left foot back, opposite arm swing, one-pixel body bob. Four-frame loop ordered left-to-right top-to-bottom. Crisp clean pixel art, deliberate chunky stepped pixels, consistent modest game-sprite resolution and simple block shading, small neon highlights, no blur. Genuine transparent background in every cell including between antlers and legs. No floor, no shadows, no backdrop, no labels, no text, no grid, no crop. Exactly four sprites total, matching the reference appearance.
